correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and normalization are reconstructed from two-stage kernel: n>=3, finite doubly-transitive group, t>=1; K has exact diagonal a and common off-diagonal (1-a)/(n-1), so Q^t=A K^{t-1}B is the claimed affine interpolation. The stationary law is f/|G|. Burnside’s two-orbit moment E_H f=2 plus support comparison of uniform H against pi gives sharp 1-2/n, reached by any g fixing exactly one point. Symmetric and affine parameters derive by exact enumeration of fixed points. The supplied standalone checker performs 8370 exact rational checks on finite instances; finite cases are not the general proof.

originality.rationale: The complete general transition factorization and transitive conjugacy-class equilibrium are credited to Feng and not counted as new. Neither Feng’s inspected full text nor the searched scientific index yielded the exact sharp two-transitive worst-start total-variation law and the parameter-separated explicit symmetric/affine families. Although short once the known factorization is applied, the specialization adds a sharp extremal principle and mixing-time classification, not merely a restatement. Residual priority risk remains for historical point-stabilizer walks.
residual_risks: General auxiliary-variable/point-stabilizer mixing literature might contain an equivalent exact 2-transitive TV result under different terminology.

Feng’s general factorization makes this a relatively short specialization; publication-priority standards could regard the specialization as anticipated despite its newly specified exact extremal content.
The one-step conjugacy-class consequence is definitely known through the cited general quotient; it is contextual, not independent novelty.

value.rationale: The sharp TV profile in a natural general 2-transitive class and the symmetry-versus-affine contrast quantify how rapidly the dual sampler forgets its starting group element, while conjugacy-class diagnostics already lose that information. The result gives exact worst-start finite-time performance, not a vague mixing upper bound, and identifies a structural source of a linear relaxation-time slowdown. The claimed value lies in the exact extremal mixing classification, not in previously known conjugacy lumping.
